items.title: Jon-Erik Kellso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Yeah, he’s a good writer, good guy.

ctx.x: Well, you’re probably familiar with what they said about you, but I wanted to get your opinion on it, regarding this particular tune, it says “Kellso tips his horn just a bit in Bix Beiderbecke’s direction. There are also occasional nods towards Billy Butterfield’s lyrical constructions and Wild Bill Davison’s ruminating low notes.” Did you know you were doing all that?

Well it wasn’t entirely conscious, but I’d have to say I’m honored that he said those nice things. I think those are certainly some of the people that influenced me a lot and © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-
especially when playing this kind of music in that kind of setting. So he was on the ball. Who was that? Was that Floyd Levin?
